fields.summary_ko.0: A total of 8 securities firms, including 6 new entrants (Mirae Asset Securities, Korea Investment & Securities, Samsung Securities, NH Investment & Securities, KB Securities, Shinhan Investment & Securities), were selected in the first round as operators of SK Hynix's stock compensation accounts.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix's stock performance bonus size this year is estimated to reach KRW 12.5 trillion, and the company plans to utilize approximately KRW 10 trillion in treasury stock for stock compensation.
